notes.title: Unveiling the UV flashlight - Sealed In Devlog #1
notes.content: [h1][b][i]Hello horror fans !!![/i][/b][/h1][p][/p][h3]I'm exited to kick off my development journey with the first Sealed In devlog, now avalaible on YouTube![/h3][h3][i]Sealed In[/i] is all about immersive puzzles, weird mannequins and a heart-taking story that you won't forget. I'm all-in into making this creepy experience that you can enjoy! I would love for you to join on this journey.[/h3][h3]In this devlog i will showcase the UV flashlight mechanic that reveals blood, messages and clues, bringing the Morgan's family secrets to life. I also share the challenges of developing this feature, balancing creepy atmosphere with clear gameplay ain't no easy task! Check out the devlog to see exclusive gameplay and hear about the progress:[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="gwp-KykNQxo;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]What do [b]YOU [/b]think of the UV flashlight? Drop your thoughts in the comments and let me know what you want to see in the next devlog: sanity system or story-related informations? Stay on your feet and i'll see you in the shadows![/h3][p][/p][h2][b]WISHLIST "SEALED IN" ON STEAM NOW! [/b]to stay updated on the 2025 release and help me bring this nightmare to life:[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831240/Sealed_In/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
